requirement: When `habeas status` or `habeas status --all` displays a Markdown table, it MUST left-align and space-pad the Definition and Evidence columns so every row, including the header and separator row, has its `|` column delimiters in the same positions. Column widths MUST be determined by the widest displayed cell in each column.
rationale:
One test covers `requirements.cli.status_table_alignment`: `tests/commands.rs#fn[status_tables_align_each_column_to_its_widest_cell]`. It carries a `{test}` reference to the requirement.

I read `src/commands.rs#fn[status_markdown_with_github]` only to confirm which table the requirement covers. It is the Definition/Evidence table built by `render_evidence_table`. The separate "Site reviews" table has different columns, so it is out of scope.

Obligations and how the test covers them:
- **Both commands.** The requirement covers `habeas status` and `habeas status --all`. The test runs four invocations: `status`, `status --all`, `status requirements.absent` and `status --all requirements.absent`. It asserts success and more than two table lines (header, separator, at least one row) for each.
- **Delimiters in the same positions on every row, including header and separator.** It collects the `|` byte indices of the header line, asserts there are three, and asserts `actual == pipes` for every table line. The header and separator are in that set.
- **Left-aligned and space-padded.** Each of the first two cells must start with one space, and the character after it must not be a space. That rejects right-aligned or centred cells. Each cell must also end with a space, so padding or a trailing space is present.
- **Width set by the widest displayed cell, in each column.** For each column it computes the maximum trimmed cell length over all lines, header and separator included. It asserts the pipe gap minus 3 equals that maximum. This rules out both too-wide and too-narrow columns.
- **Header can be the widest cell.** In the glob runs for `requirements.absent`, the Evidence cell "Missing" (7 characters) is shorter than the header "Evidence" (8). In the unfiltered runs, the data cells are wider than the headers. So the test exercises both the header and the data rows as the widest cell.
- **Separator row.** It asserts both separator cells trim to `---`, and the pipe-position check forces them to be padded to column width.
- **Content.** The final block checks the Evidence labels (Valid, Missing, Determination false, Invalid) for the fixture's rows. This confirms the table has varied cell widths, so padding is actually exercised.

I found no obligation or boundary left untested, and no assertion that contradicts the requirement. The table uses only ASCII cells, and the requirement names no wide-character or escaping case. I found no acknowledgments, and none are needed.
